registration_scope: BudgetStop semantics were frozen in the evaluation design and original PILOT_PLAN before tune/pilot; this artifact binds their executable analysis adapter before analysis.

budget_stop_analysis_policy.analysis_only_mapping: Map BudgetStop to statistical Completed only when an actual evaluator/rubric-bound finite score and an observed finite nonnegative deployment_wall_seconds are both present; otherwise use Unresolved.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.audit: Retain original and statistical status counts and every BudgetStop adaptation separately.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.meaning: Resolved statistical observation only; no claim of original execution success or acceptable quality.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.original_terminal_status: Preserve BudgetStop and the original paired rows.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.required_cost_scope: Measured deployment wall cost used by the frozen utility; energy and provider prices need not be known for this mapping.

utility_derivation: For a resolved BudgetStop, verify existing finite analysis_utility against score minus latency_weight times deployment_wall_seconds; if the derived field is absent, compute it from those recorded inputs. No counterfactual score or time is generated.
format_stage: Final exact Ruff byte binding; the recorded AST is unchanged from the prospectively frozen adapter. The registered_utc and design policy registration time are preserved.
